zh.text: 首页新增「部署服务端」入口，位于服务端按钮右侧，可一键部署服务端到指定目录。
部署目标目录支持已解压但尚未安装的完整服务端包，无需再选择空目录，直接进入安装向导。

en.text: Added a Deploy Server entry on the home page, next to the server button, for one-click server deployment to a chosen directory.
Deployment now accepts an already-extracted but not yet installed server package as the target folder, so an empty folder is no longer required and installation starts directly.
